name: Resourceful
description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

name: Skillful
description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

name: Versatile
description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice; Skilled is recommended.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

name: Elven Lineage
description: Choose Drow (Darkvision 120 feet, Dancing Lights), High Elf (Prestidigitation, swappable each Long Rest), or Wood Elf (Speed 35 feet, Druidcraft); you learn a lineage spell at levels 3 and 5, castable once per Long Rest without a slot. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability, chosen with the lineage.

name: Fey Ancestry
description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

name: Keen Senses
description: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

name: Trance
description: You don't need to sleep, magic can't put you to sleep, and you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

name: Dwarven Resilience
description: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

name: Dwarven Toughness
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

name: Stonecunning
description: As a Bonus Action, gain Tremorsense 60 feet for 10 minutes while on or touching stone. Uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

name: Brave
description: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

name: Halfling Nimbleness
description: You can move through the space of any creature a size larger than you, but can't stop in it.

name: Luck
description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you reroll it and must use the new roll.

name: Naturally Stealthy
description: You can take the Hide action while obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

name: Draconic Ancestry
description: Choose a dragon for your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance: Black or Copper (Acid), Blue or Bronze (Lightning), Brass, Gold, or Red (Fire), Green (Poison), Silver or White (Cold).

name: Breath Weapon
description: Replace one attack with a 15-foot Cone or 30-foot Line of your ancestry's damage: Dexterity save (DC 8 + Con modifier + Proficiency Bonus), 1d10 on a failure, half on a success; 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at 11, 4d10 at 17. Uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

name: Damage Resistance
description: You have Resistance to the damage type of your Draconic Ancestry.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

name: Draconic Flight
description: From level 5, as a Bonus Action you sprout spectral wings and gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

name: Gnomish Cunning
description: You have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Gnomish Lineage
description: Forest Gnome: Minor Illusion, and Speak with Animals always prepared, castable without a slot Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. Rock Gnome: Mending and Prestidigitation, and you can build Tiny clockwork devices (three at a time). Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: Take the Dash action as a Bonus Action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses equal to your Proficiency Bonus per Short or Long Rest.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

name: Relentless Endurance
description: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead. Once per Long Rest.

name: Darkvision
description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

name: Fiendish Legacy
description: Choose Abyssal (Poison Resistance, Poison Spray), Chthonic (Necrotic Resistance, Chill Touch), or Infernal (Fire Resistance, Fire Bolt); you learn a legacy spell at levels 3 and 5, castable once per Long Rest without a slot. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability, chosen with the legacy.

name: Otherworldly Presence
description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, cast with your Fiendish Legacy spellcasting ability.

name: Giant Ancestry
description: Choose one boon, used Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest: Cloud's Jaunt (Bonus Action teleport 30 feet), Fire's Burn (+1d10 Fire on a hit), Frost's Chill (+1d6 Cold and -10 feet Speed on a hit), Hill's Tumble (knock a Large or smaller target Prone), Stone's Endurance (Reaction: reduce damage by 1d12 + Con modifier), or Storm's Thunder (Reaction: 1d8 Thunder to an attacker within 60 feet).

name: Large Form
description: From level 5, as a Bonus Action become Large for 10 minutes, with Advantage on Strength checks and +10 feet Speed. Once per Long Rest.

name: Powerful Build
description: You have Advantage on checks to end the Grappled condition, and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.
